comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a 5,000 current-year rental PROFIT combines with an 8,000 prior years' unallowed loss (Form 8582 line 1d = -3,000); active participation Yes takes the special allowance, so the net -3,000 subtracts (income 45,250, tax 3,305 = table(29,525 midpoint), overpaid 2,695). fully_at_risk is deliberately ABSENT: the current year is a profit, and the threshold rule says section 465 is not asked - this fixture pins that too, alongside the carry-in's whole served path.
